basis: 1F (Rose daily work plan, 2026-11-05): build, sign, verify and publish each flavor daily through its existing manual entry point, isolated per flavor; manual dispatch stays. Source only: no schedule exists and every lane is disabled until an owner-approved activation change. scripts/daily-release.py reads this file.
activation: Activation is one reviewed change: it enables a lane here and adds the daily schedule to .github/workflows/daily-release.yml. Both still need owner approval; neither is part of this source.

window.note: Chief publishes the chosen daily window in Pacific time; the activation change writes it here and as the workflow's schedule.
